label: AFP GoedelGod.thy, theorem Monotheism: at every world, any two GOD_LIKE_5 beings…, by Case-analysis
meaning: AFP Monotheism (metis Flawlessness G_def). Let x, y be God-like at w and x have Φ there. By excluded middle Φ is positive or not. If positive, y has it. If not, x lacks it by flawlessness: contradiction.
